title: Tumble and the Ten-Jump Skipping Rope
moral: If you don't get it the first time, keep trying, and you'll get a little better every time.
description: It's Skipping Day in Clover Wood, and whoever does ten jumps in a row wins a shiny star ribbon! Count from one to ten with Pip, Tumble and Nana Hoot as Tumble bonks, wobbles, tangles and sneezes his way through some very silly tries.

popups.sub: ten jumps for a star ribbon

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Today was Skipping Day in Clover Wood!
Nana Hoot brought a long, looong rope. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! A skippity-ropey-thingy! Super-duper!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! It's a skipping rope, Pip. Whoever does ten jumps in a row gets a shiny star ribbon!
Ten jumps? That's a lot! Tumble's trunk gave a nervous little... HONK!

narration.text: First, Pip showed everyone how to skip. Can you count his jumps with me? Ready?
One... two... three... four... five... six... seven... eight... nine... TEN!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ten jumps! Easy-peasy, lemon-squeezy-sneezy!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Wow, Pip! Now it's my turn. I hope my feet know how!

narration.text: Tumble took a big breath. Jump number one... the rope caught on his trunk! Ka-BONK!
He went wibble-wobble, round and round, like a spinning top!
Try number two! One, two, three... uh-oh! The rope wrapped round and round him like a birthday present!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! I'm a present with a bow on top!
How many jumps did Tumble do that time?
Three! Great counting, friends!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I can't do it. I'll never, ever get to ten.
Pip didn't laugh at him. He sat right next to his friend.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: When I learned, I fell down a hundred-zillion times! Nana, what's the secret?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: The secret is... to watch the rope... and count... and... zzzzz.
Uh-oh! Nana fell asleep! Her glasses slid down, down, down her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! The secret is: try again, and keep counting!

One, two, three, four, five, six... then a butterfly landed on Tumble's trunk. Tickle, tickle!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!
WHOOSH! The giant sneeze blew Nana's glasses right onto Pip's nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee-hee! Look at me! I'm a wise old fox now!
